name: action-umami-report
description: GitHub Action Umami Report - for a given period and time unit, use Umami API to produce report as file or output variables
author: Boly38 <boly38@gmail.com>

overrides_doc.undici: Security fixes for @actions/http-client transitive dependency - patched advisories require >=7.30.1
overrides_doc.glob: Security fix for CVE-2025-64756 (Command injection via CLI) - transitive dep from mocha/c8 - See: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5j98-mcp5-4vw2
overrides_doc.js-yaml: Security fixes for mocha transitive dependency - patched advisories require >=4.3.2
overrides_doc.diff: Security patch for known vulnerabilities - transitive dep from mocha/sinon
overrides_doc.minimatch: Security fixes for c8/mocha transitive dependency - patched advisories require >=9.0.7
overrides_doc.brace-expansion: Security fixes for minimatch transitive dependency - patched advisories require >=2.1.7
overrides_doc.serialize-javascript: Security fixes for mocha transitive dependency - patched advisories require >=7.1.3
overrides_doc.decode-uri-component: Security fix for umami-api-client transitive dependency - patched advisory requires >=0.5.0
